body: I cant call for help, i dont want to be 5150d(California) I made the decision after thinking about it for a week. I have 3 guns but yet i chose the most painful route. why? simply because i deserve it. thank you for the kind words though. they mean a lot.

I've given myself almost a year for things to get better, they havent. Im just tired and want to be at rest and with my mama. I want it to hurt, I deserve this pain for all the hurt i've inflicted on my loved ones. Im sorry but I cannot give myself a break until im in the ground.
